about: Prop set for facemaker, generated on Piranesi (FLUX.1 schnell or FLUX.2 Klein, both Apache-2.0). Released CC0, committed under public/editor/gen/. Hand-drawn SVGs in public/editor/ stay. See research/05-asset-sources-2026-09-27.md.

output.background_removal: Generate on flat pure white (#FFFFFF), then cut out with rembg (MIT) or BiRefNet (MIT), trim to content, pad to square with 16 px margin, resize to 512.
output.pick: operator picks one seed per id; keep rejected seeds out of the repo

style_prefix: flat cartoon sticker, kid-friendly, bold clean outlines, bright saturated colours, simple shading, single object centered, front view, isolated on plain white background, no text, no shadow on background
negative: text, watermark, logo, signature, photo, realistic, person, face, hands, multiple objects, frame, border, background scenery, blurry, gore, scary
